Purpose: working towards business objectives, one knowledge mark.

items.prompt: Explain why a small Namibian workshop with a Friday delivery commitment needs clear allocation of work and daily progress checks. [6]
items.canonical_answer: Clear allocation identifies who performs each task, reducing duplicated work and unfinished stages when workers follow the plan. In this workshop that helps necessary jobs be completed before Friday. Daily progress checks can reveal a delay while time remains to respond. If trained workers and equipment are available, the manager can adjust the schedule, improving the chance of meeting the delivery commitment.
marking_guidance: Starting point: clear allocation and progress checks, two knowledge marks.
Context: the small workshop, Friday commitment and unfinished jobs support two distinct applications.
Because mechanism: coordination reduces duplication and checking reveals delay; one developed explanation for each.
Consequence: connect each effect to the business delivery objective, with the resource condition kept visible.
